detail.longDescription: I am building an application and I chose NestJs with Prisma. New prisma version 8 was released and I want to give it a try, but by default prisma is using commonjs and nestjs uses nodenext, so I want to edit the migration file and run it: node migrations/app/\<migration label\>/migration.ts I have to change the package.json type on module, which is annoying. Is there any other way to do it, "the right way for these type of frameworks"? Thanks
